title: {Syn} Union-Find Makes Connectivity Feel Constant
content:
The disjoint-set union structure supports merging sets and asking whether two items are in the same set. With path compression and union by rank, operations are almost constant time in practice.

It is the quiet engine behind Kruskal minimum spanning tree, image segmentation, offline connectivity, and many contest problems.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
